_meta.description: Authoritative source registry for values used by TRIARCHY. This file is intentionally separate from the five locked gameplay contracts so NASA data can be refreshed without changing their schemas.
_meta.policy: A numeric value may be marked verified:true in a gameplay contract only when its source_id, product/version, spatial or table reference, units, and retrieval date are recorded here or in the field source text. Derived gameplay modifiers must remain identified as derived.
_meta.refresh_policy: Check source landing pages before each release and refresh snapshots when a source product version changes. Preserve the prior value and provenance in version control.

sources.title: Life Support Baseline Values and Assumptions Document, NASA/TP-2015-218570, Rev1
LOLA Reduced Data Records and gridded elevation products
sources.version_or_coverage: NASA GSFC PGDA 5 m south-pole landing-site products; Connecting Ridge (Site01) and Shackleton Rim (Site04) sampled on 2026-09-28
sources.measurement_note: Record latitude, east-positive longitude, raster/product identifier, pixel resolution, and sampling method for every site value. Ridge A and Shadow Zone use 5 m documented elevation and slope products at shared X/Y coordinates.

sources.title: LROC QuickMap lunar polar illumination layers
sources.version_or_coverage: WAC_POLE_ILL_PCT_SOUTH_100M, PDS4 v2.0; 88–90°S, 100 m/pixel; percentage of observations illuminated during the source map period
sources.measurement_note: Illumination percentage must retain the layer name, time interval, coordinates, and sampling method; it is then normalized to a solar-generation gameplay modifier. Ridge A and Shadow Zone have recorded sampled values; remaining sites have not.

sources.title: LEND Derived Data Records
sources.data_kind: neutron flux and hydrogen-related resource potential
sources.version_or_coverage: PDS LRO LEND archive, Release 67 current at retrieval; LEND_RDR_ALDS_20090915, 2009-09-15 through 2011-12-11, 0.5° × 0.5° south-polar cells
sources.measurement_note: LEND_RDR_ALDS_20090915 stores CSETN relative count rates and statistical errors, not hydrogen ppm. The two site entries retain their sampled map-cell rates in field provenance and use the separately cited NASA LEND regional model for >88° latitude: approximately 140 ppmw H (0.13 ± 0.02 wt% WEH). This is regional evidence, never confirmed extractable water or a direct landing-point assay.

sources.title: Background and Lunar Neutron Populations Detected by LEND and Average Concentration of Near-Surface Hydrogen near the Moon's Poles
sources.version_or_coverage: Livengood et al., Planetary and Space Science 162 (2018); approximately 140 ppmw H above 88° north or south latitude, 0.13 ± 0.02 wt% WEH
sources.measurement_note: Both selected sites are south of 88°. This result does not resolve differences between their individual 0.5° LEND cells.

sources.title: Cosmic Ray Telescope for the Effects of Radiation data archive
sources.version_or_coverage: Use a documented CRaTER dose or flux product appropriate to the selected baseline
sources.measurement_note: CRaTER observations are orbital-environment data. Surface dose in the game is a separately documented derived model, adjusted by shielding and terrain factors.
